page.layout: One column of running text with marginal notes at the right. Top: continuation of the previous page's paragraph, then a rule. Centre: heading "CAPUT XII." with an italic title. Below: the body paragraph, notes in the right margin. Bottom right: catchword. Bottom centre: signature.

page.notes: The first line of the top paragraph is continuous from the previous page. The "sitamen" word is broken across lines as "si ta-men" and is marked [?] for the uncertain reading. The notes at the right margin have no reference marks, so each is placed beside the line where it stands. The "dicen-" catchword is at the bottom right. The stray mark at the bottom left and the watermark at the bottom right are not transcribed.
